description: Street Tree Data is a dataset listed in City of Toronto open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Toronto. This data primarily pertains to City-owned trees located on road allowances across Toronto. The intent of the database is to provide an inventory of City owned-trees on the road allowance for inspection and maintenance. Coverage: Toronto. The portal files it under the publisher City of Toronto. Its tags are street tree data, tree locations. It offers 15 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, GPKG, SHP. The portal shows 2026-06-04 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-toronto-portal.
